{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check if any row has revenue = '999,999.99' — the QA orders
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999,999.99'

print(f"Number of rows with revenue '999,999.99': {qa_mask.sum()}")
print(f"Rows with '999,999.99': {df.loc[qa_mask, 'order_id'].tolist()}")

# Check if any of these are in the converted group
converted_qa = df.loc[qa_mask, 'converted']
print(f"Converted QA orders: {converted_qa.tolist()}")

# Since the QA orders are not in the converted group, they do not affect the mean age of converted customers
# Therefore, they can be ignored for this analysis"}
